wars.name: Rebellion of the Three Guards
wars.outcome: Zhou victory: Yin destroyed in the second year (1041) and Wu Geng killed; in the third year the royal army attacked the Huai peoples and then defeated Yan; Guan, Yan, Pugu and Cai were dissolved (Cai later revived), Yan's land went to Lu, Pugu's to Qi, Yin to…

certainty.note: Nothing on the page fixes the extent of Wu Geng's domain; Yin and its surroundings only.
